mostWorthwhile.text: Returning nutrients through decomposition to growing roots was the most worthwhile sequence: it made forest renewal concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making a storm was the least engaging moment; it was the only offered action and its connection to the goals was initially unclear.

surprise.text: Forest transpiration contributing to rainfall far downwind was an interesting connection.

arbitrary.text: Rainfall plus air initially felt arbitrary because I could not see why a storm was needed; its role in producing fallen wood became clear afterward.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see more connections like the contrast between decomposition and carbon preservation in peat.
